basics.label: AI solution design / Editorial workflows / Learning materials
basics.summary:
I bring AI into real editorial work: I find where it fits, design and build the solution, and help people adopt it.

I'm a publishing editor at Otava Oppiminen, working on digital learning materials in mathematics and science. Since August 2026 my focus has been AI implementation in editorial work and content production, as part of Otava's central AI team. I started my career as a mathematics teacher, and I still explain technical ideas the way a good lesson does.

projects.name: Alt text that travels with every image
projects.description: Designed a pipeline that writes accessibility descriptions into image metadata (IPTC) in Otava's digital asset management system, so alt text is written once and reused across products. Wrote the technical documentation in Finnish and English.

projects.name: Mapping manuscripts to the national curriculum
projects.description: Developed a retrieve-then-judge method that matches textbook manuscripts to the objectives of the Finnish core curriculum. Retrieval narrows the candidates, a language model judges the fit, and an editor reviews the result.

projects.name: A shared toolkit for editors
projects.description: Setting up one home for small internal tools, available behind company single sign-on. The tools include a translation helper for Excel-based content and a Finnish proofreading assistant built on a language-model API. I also train colleagues to use AI in their own work.

projects.name: Koepaja: exams for Finnish teachers
projects.description: A single-file exam builder with five question types, math typesetting and drag-and-drop ordering. A companion AI skill generates new tasks in the tool's import format, so teachers can review AI-written questions before using them.

projects.name: Titration simulation
projects.description: An interactive titration simulation for school chemistry, with correct pH behaviour and accessible controls

projects.name: Income-protection visualisation
projects.description: An income-protection visualisation for an insurance company, built in React

projects.name: Teoriatreeni
projects.description: Teoriatreeni, a driving-theory practice app with 177 questions checked against current traffic law
